translations.web: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.
translations.bsb: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the first wool sheared from your flock.
translations.kjv: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give
translations.asv: The first-fruits of thy grain, of thy new wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
